name: Artemis
subtitle: Lunar Huntress
lore: Mercurial Artemis is a goddess of contradictions: guardian of beasts, yet patron of hunters; goddess of the moon, though the moon is its own deity; chaste, yet associated with childbirth; protector, yet swift to curse mortals in anger; erratic, yet loyal to Order. Since the Shattering, even her priests and fellow gods are often uncertain what to expect of her.
divinity_generator: Gain [40] Divinity when inflicting damage to an enemy. Gain an additional [100] Divinity when defeating an enemy.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Awaken the ability: Thrill of the Hunt
Ignore DEF +10%, DMG Multiplier +30%, Divinity Multiplier +20%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Lunar Barrage
skills.description: Attack all enemies 3 times. Increase this hero’s Divinity by 1% for each enemy hit.
skills.awakening_bonus: Increase the Divinity by an additional 5% for each enemy defeated

skills.name: Thrill of the Hunt
skills.description: After defeating an enemy, this hero’s next attack will inflict 50% increased damage.
skills.awakening_bonus: If an ally is defeated, this hero’s next attack will inflict 100% increase damage.

skills.name: Moonlight Union
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 2 times. Has a 50% chance to place [mechanic:def-down-ii] on the target for 2 turns. If Apollo is on the team, he will join in the attack.

skills.name: Wrath of the Wild
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy. Increase the damage inflicted by 10% for each defeated enemy.
skills.awakening_bonus: Place [Banish] on all defeated enemies for 1 turn.

imprint_passive: After defeating an enemy, this hero’s next attack will inflict 25% increased damage.
